verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official CLI (newrelic-cli on GitHub). Its documented capabilities include entity search, deployment markers, tags, workloads, credential profiles and machine-readable JSON/YAML output for CI/CD and scripted use. It also has companion CLIs: nr1, which can run NRQL queries, and nrdiag for diagnostics. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agent-driven workflows, and any explicitly AI/agent-oriented CLI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can use the New Relic CLI to manage entity tags, define workloads, record deployment markers, and much more.
Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.
--format string    output text format [JSON, Text, YAML] (default "JSON")
Entity Search: Search for entities across all your New Relic accounts
nr1 nrql | Fetches data using NRQL.
